test "a registry routes each key to its own worker", seed 7
  the test sent Bump("a") to Registry #0
  Registry #0 took Bump("a")
  Registry #0 sent Count to Worker #1
  Worker #1 took Count
  the test sent Bump("a") to Registry #0
  Registry #0 took Bump("a")
  Registry #0 sent Count to Worker #1
  Worker #1 took Count
  the test sent Bump("b") to Registry #0
  Registry #0 took Bump("b")
  Registry #0 sent Count to Worker #2
  Worker #2 took Count
  the test sent Keys to Registry #0
  Registry #0 took Keys
test "a worker whose key the registry forgets ends, and the one it keeps lives", seed 7
  the test sent Bump("a") to Registry #0
  Registry #0 took Bump("a")
  Registry #0 sent Count to Worker #1
  Worker #1 took Count
  the test sent Bump("b") to Registry #0
  Registry #0 took Bump("b")
  Registry #0 sent Count to Worker #2
  Worker #2 took Count
  the test sent Forget("a") to Registry #0
  the test sent Keys to Registry #0
  Registry #0 took Forget("a")
  Registry #0 took Keys
  the test sent Bump("b") to Registry #0
  Registry #0 took Bump("b")
  Registry #0 sent Count to Worker #2
  Worker #2 took Count
